7585.title: ACP running presentation misses delayed arguments
7585.rootCauseOneLine: The nonterminal ACP refresh gate handles only commands, leaving read/search presentation stale after merged arguments arrive.
7585.proposedFix: Refresh changed read/search presentation under the original item shape and provider key, preserving output and two-shape completion.
7585.caveats: Protocol-level reproduction only; no live provider, Windows, or browser session. Regression source is embedded in the report per reports repository policy.
